issues.field: decision to pay / referral to handler
issues.recorded: status pending_approval with payout €1200 paid automatically (assessor required: no)
issues.should_be: The claim must be referred to a claims handler and not paid automatically, because the other driver's vehicle is a commercial vehicle
issues.evidence: Handler playbook (given in the review request): 'When the other driver is a commercial vehicle (van, truck, lorry, delivery vehicle), refer the claim to a handler so Veridia can recover the money from their insurer.' The accident report (accident_report_signed.pdf, Vehicle B section) states Vehicle B is a 'Ford Transit Custom', VEHICLE TYPE 'Van', policyholder 'Rapid Livraisons SARL (company vehicle)', driver Mr. Marc Dubois — i.e. a delivery van of a commercial company, which triggers the playbook rule.

verdict.summary: All recorded facts match the email and documents (incident 2026-10-12 reported 2026-10-14 within the 5-day deadline of contract Article 4.1, C2 collision covered in the Policy Schedule, repair cost €1200 = total incl. VAT per Article 1, not at fault with identified third party Rapid Livraisons SARL so the €0 deductible waiver of Article 5.2 applies, no exclusion under Article 3, all three C2-required documents provided and belonging to Claire Martin's Peugeot 208 FG-218-LM, no assessor needed since €1200 ≤ €1,500 per Article 6.1), but the other vehicle is a commercial delivery van, so the playbook requires referral to a handler and the claim must not be paid automatically.
